whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Fitnation Gym,

I noticed your gym has strong 4.5★ reviews with 200+ happy members in Kadamkuan, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new membership inquiries.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://fitnation.arclanestudios.space

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi Fitnation Gym team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Fitnation Gym) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya?

*(If they checked it):* "Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your prime location above Domino's Pizza in Kadamkuan. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"

*(If they haven't checked yet):* "No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback."

Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
